relationships.mechanism: In Monument of Triumph (Anti-Champion 2.0), Barrier stuns are intrinsic to weapon frames: bring a Barrier-stunning Legendary frame or a confirmed anti-Barrier exotic. The pre-MoT path of stunning Barriers with Radiant or Volatile Rounds was removed; those buffs now only add champion damage, so a build relying on them will fail to stun.

relationships.mechanism: Arc combatant shields take reduced damage from off-element sources and burst when hit with matching Arc damage. Under the Match Game challenge modifier this becomes decisive: non-matching damage is heavily reduced, so an Arc answer (weapon or ability) is needed to break the shield at all.

relationships.mechanism: A surge boosts outgoing damage of its element. When Arc surge is active, prioritise Arc weapons and, where the build allows, an Arc subclass to convert the surge into real damage. Note: in MoT the fixed weekly GM surge strip was removed; surges now appear as activity/launch-card modifiers rather than a guaranteed weekly element.
